extensionName.description: Name of the extension, shown in the browser's extension list. The product name is not translated.

extensionDescription.message: Bloquea los sitios web que distraen durante tus sesiones de concentración de Keitora.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension, shown in the browser's extension list. At most 132 characters.

blockPageTitle.description: Title of the browser tab that shows the block page.

blockPageHeading.description: Main heading of the block page, naming the blocked site.

blockPageHeadingUnknownSite.description: Main heading of the block page when the blocked address cannot be named, for example when it is not a web address.

blockPageExplanation.message: Este sitio está bloqueado durante tu sesión de Keitora.
blockPageExplanation.description: Sentence under the heading of the block page explaining why the site is blocked. It must stay true in every phase: a blocklist may lift the block during breaks or keep it, and the page does not know which, so it does not say when the site comes back.

blockPageRemaining.description: Label next to the countdown on the block page, as in '14:32 remaining'.

blockPagePhaseFocus.description: Name of the focus phase, shown next to the countdown on the block page.

blockPagePhaseShortBreak.description: Name of the short break phase, shown next to the countdown on the block page.

blockPagePhaseLongBreak.description: Name of the long break phase, shown next to the countdown on the block page.

blockPageCycle.description: Which cycle of the session is running, shown next to the countdown on the block page.

blockPageStrictUntil.message: Modo estricto: no se puede desbloquear hasta las $TIME$
blockPageStrictUntil.description: Notice on the block page saying that a strict session cannot be unblocked before the time it ends.

blockPageStrictLocked.message: Modo estricto: no se puede desbloquear hasta que termine la sesión
blockPageStrictLocked.description: Notice on the block page for a strict session whose end time is unknown.

blockPageNoData.message: Keitora no puede leer la sesión ahora mismo. El sitio sigue bloqueado.
blockPageNoData.description: Shown on the block page instead of the countdown when there is no session to show, or the extension cannot reach Keitora.

blockPageFooter.description: Footer of the block page, saying which program blocked the site.
